item.title: Augsburg boss Manuel Baum handed touchline ban for Hoffenheim clash
item.description: Augsburg boss Manuel Baum handed touchline ban for Hoffenheim clash FC Augsburg have confirmed that head coach Manuel Baum will serve a one-match touchline ban following his dismissal during Sunday's 3-1 victory over Mainz. Baum was shown a straight red card by referee Martin Petersen shortly before half-time after delaying a Mainz throw-in. The DFB's sports court has subsequently handed the 47-year-old a one-match ban for unsporting conduct, meaning he will be absent from the dugout when Augsburg travel to Hoffenheim on Sunday. The suspension comes into effect 30 minutes before kick-off and remains in place until 30 minutes after the final whistle. During this period, Baum will be prohibited from entering the dressing room, players' tunnel and technical area, as well as communicating with his players or coaching staff, either directly or indirectly. Both Baum and Augsburg have accepted the ruling, meaning the decision is final. The Fuggerstädter will be looking to build on Sunday's victory over Mainz, which brought an end to a seven-match winless run in the Bundesliga.

item.title: Barberton basketball great, part of 1976 title team Mark Bodnar dies
item.description: Marty Bodnar always knew where his twin brother Mark was on the basketball court, and vice versa. Together, that brotherly intuition helped them lead Barberton — along with Carter Scott, who with the Bodnars formed one of the original Big 3s, before it was such a trend — to an undefeated record and a class AAA state championship in 1976. Marty and Mark were brothers, teammates, best friends and a major part of each other’s support system for more than six decades. Following a multi-year battle with cancer, Mark Bodnar died last week. He was 67 years old. The Bodnar twins were instrumental players during that legendary Barberton run along with Scott and coach Jack Greynolds. As juniors, they helped lead Barberton to a 26-0 record and the state title. They extended that winning streak to 51 games the next season, though it was eventually snapped in the 1977 state title game. During that championship run in 1976, Marty Bodnar hit a decisive basket in the closing moments to seal the win over Canton McKinley in the regional final. The assist, via a perfectly-placed bounce pass, came from his twin brother Mark, who knew exactly where to put it. “He just always knew where I was at,” Marty said, speaking to the Beacon Journal on Monday, Nov. 23. “He’s been assisting me for 67 years. I’m gonna miss him. It’s just a sixth sense we had. I dunno, I can’t explain it. “But he was there, back in those days, and he was assisting me in so many ways throughout my life, and I was assisting him.” In 2024, that '76 Barberton squad was inducted into the Ohio Basketball Hall of Fame . After the success in high school, both brothers went to play at Michigan. Marty still lives in the Ann Arbor area. A few years ago, he was asked by a friend to speak to a fifth-grade basketball team. It just so happened that former Michigan coach and current Los Angeles Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh had a son on that team. After Marty Bodnar spoke to the kids, Harbaugh walked up and asked what it was like playing with his twin brother for so long, something with which the well-known football coach has some experience due to his brother John, coach of the New York Giants, being involved at the top levels of the sport. Marty told Harbaugh that he and Mark just had a connection they couldn’t explain, and it was something they treasured. “I paused, and then I said, ‘I always knew where he was on the court, and he always knew where I was,’” Marty Bodnar said. “It was just a sixth sense. A bond that twins have.” Marty noted how appreciative the family has been to see an outpouring of messages come in from all around the country, including those with a Barberton connection. Scott, the third member of that dynamic title-winning trio, called from California to offer his condolences. It showed how close the basketball community had remained after so many years. item.title: Como plot shock transfer move for Man Utd outcast Joshua Zirkzee after Moise Kean injury disaster
item.description: Chelsea FC v Manchester United - Premier League 2026/27 - Getty Images Sport Como have emerged as potential suitors for out-of-favour Manchester United forward Joshua Zirkzee ahead of the January transfer window. Cesc Fabregas' side are exploring attacking options after summer signing Moise Kean suffered a major injury setback that will sideline the Italy international for several more months. Como eye Zirkzee after Moise Kean injury blow Como have joined a growing list of Serie A clubs interested in signing Zirkzee during the January transfer window. According to Gianluca Di Marzio , the Italian side are weighing up attacking reinforcements following a major injury setback to Kean. Fabregas confirmed over the weekend that Kean faces another lengthy spell on the sidelines after aggravating an issue in training last week. The Como manager stated that the striker will be out for "another few months, not weeks", forcing the club to reassess their forward options. Recurring tibia issue sidelines Kean for months Kean has battled a recurring tibia problem for several months, an issue that predates his move to Como. Despite playing through pain earlier in the campaign, the 26-year-old has endured repeated setbacks and has not featured since representing Italy during the September-October international break. Just as he neared a return to full training, Kean suffered another fitness relapse that may now require surgical intervention. With the forward ruled out for the foreseeable future, Como are "exploring their options" in the market, though no formal negotiations have opened with Manchester United. Zirkzee struggles for minutes at Old Trafford A return to Italy could offer a lifeline to Zirkzee, who has endured a frustrating spell since arriving at Old Trafford from Bologna for an initial €42.5m in 2024. The Netherlands international has fallen down the pecking order and is yet to start a single competitive fixture for United during the 2026-27 season. Zirkzee has accumulated just 231 minutes of action across 11 substitute appearances in the Premier League, Champions League and EFL Cup. While he appeared surplus to requirements under former boss Michael Carrick, his future under new head coach Mauricio Pochettino remains uncertain. Serie A rivals monitor United forward Como are far from the only Italian club tracking Zirkzee's availability ahead of the winter window. Napoli are also reportedly keeping tabs on the Dutchman as they prepare to enter the market for a striker should Lorenzo Lucca depart the club. Zirkzee's proven track record in Serie A ensures he remains a sought-after target across the division. Alongside interest from Como and Napoli, the forward has previously been linked with moves to Juventus, Roma and Milan during his difficult stint in England.

item.title: SEC Championship Game: Paths for Alabama, Texas or Tennessee to play Georgia
item.description: ATLANTA, GEORGIA - DECEMBER 06: A view of the SEC Championship logo on the field prior to the 2025 SEC Championship between the Georgia Bulldogs and Alabama Crimson Tide at Mercedes-Benz Stadium on December 06, 2025 in Atlanta, Georgia. (Photo by Todd Kirkland/Getty Images) Todd Kirkland The 2026 SEC Championship Game will make history as the conference’s final championship game before the College Football Playoff expands to 24 teams in 2027. [DOWNLOAD: Free WSB-TV News app for alerts as news breaks ] No. 1 Georgia already punched its ticket after its win on Saturday. It will be the program’s sixth straight appearance in the championship game. But the Bulldogs are still waiting to learn their opponent with three teams in the running: No. 3 Alabama, No. 5 Texas and No. 9 Tennessee. Here’s what each team needs to happen to advance. ALABAMA MAKES SEC CHAMPIONSHIP GAME IF... There are two paths for the Crimson Tide. Alabama beats Auburn plus Texas loses to Texas A&M and Tennessee loses to Vanderbilt OR Alabama beats Auburn plus wins from Tennessee, LSU and Mississippi State In the second scenario, Alabama would hold the conference opponent win percentage tiebreaker, despite its loss to Tennessee. Georgia defeated Alabama back in September for its first win in Tuscaloosa since 2007. The two sides have met in the SEC Championship Game five times. TEXAS MAKES SEC CHAMPIONSHIP GAME IF... There are three paths for the Longhorns. Texas beats Texas A&M and Alabama loses to Auburn OR Texas beats Texas A&M and Tennessee loses to Vanderbilt OR Texas beats Texas A&M and either Mississippi State or LSU lose No matter the path, Texas has to beat Texas A&M on Friday night or it will miss out on the SEC Championship Game. And their playoff fate will be left to the College Football Playoff committee. Georgia and Texas met in the 2024 SEC Championship Game with the Bulldogs winning in overtime. TENNESSEE MAKES SEC CHAMPIONSHIP GAME IF... For the Vols, there is only one path to make it to the SEC Championship Game. Tennessee needs Texas A&M to beat Texas on Friday night and the Vols must beat Vanderbilt. Georgia and Tennessee did not play this season after the SEC conference schedule moved to 10 games. It’s the first time since 1991 that the Bulldogs and Vols haven’t met in a season. The two programs have never faced each other in the SEC Championship Game. WHEN IS THE SEC CHAMPIONSHIP GAME? The SEC Championship Game is set for Saturday, Dec. 5 with a 4 p.m. kickoff at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. The game will air on Channel 2. [SIGN UP: WSB-TV Daily Headlines Newsletter ]

‘Every night’ – Luka Doncic’s latest LA Lakers antics have left NBA fans ‘exhausted’
item.description: Photo by Ryan Sirius Sun/Getty Images Despite being one of the best players in the league, Luka Doncic can sometimes be a divisive figure in the league because of the way he approaches defenders. In particular, it is Doncic’s ability and constant efforts to draw fouls that frustrate a large portion of the fanbase, as they believe he focuses too much on getting to the free-throw line. For a player of Doncic’s offensive calibre, the fixation on trying to draw fouls does tend to hold his game back on occasion, with one example during the LA Lakers’ win over the Utah Jazz proving to be the perfect example. Luka Doncic’s eight-second violation while trying to draw a foul draws negative reactions from fans In the early stages of the Los Angeles Lakers’ win over the Utah Jazz, Luka Doncic was bringing the ball up when he found himself being picked up full-court by his former Dallas Mavericks teammate Josh Green. In an effort to draw a foul before crossing the half-court line, Doncic would end up with an eight-second violation, having not brought the ball up within eight seconds of the shot clock starting after collecting the inbound pass. Understandably, such a rookie mistake from a veteran like Doncic proved to be frustrating, especially considering many fans saw this as a blatant attempt to draw a foul rather than get a good look on the offensive end. One fan wrote: “Every night it’s something else from him. Just a whiny-a** b****. Exhausted by all of it, y’all.” Another fan added: “Watching Luka is infuriating. He’s so good; just play the f****** game you’re paid millions of dollars to play! $200/ticket to watch this? I want my money back, Adam Silver!” A third fan even observed Doncic’s extra effort to draw a foul: “Dude was loading up that head whiplash for the whistle!” A fourth fan even went as far as to say that the Dallas Mavericks were right to trade Luka Doncic: “Nico was right, man; f****** trash player!” Focusing on his performance on the night, a fifth fan called out Doncic’s woes on the offensive end: “Another inefficient night vs. one of the worst defensive teams in the league.” And lastly, one final fan claimed this reaction from Doncic was a sign of his irritation with the Lakers: “Is it me or does it seem like Luka is unhappy? He seems extremely frustrated every game!” Doncic had a remarkably poor night against the Jazz, scoring 28 points on 8/24 shooting from the field and 3/14 shooting from beyond the arc. While he did dish out eight assists, Doncic’s four personal fouls in the first half got him in trouble, and forced the Lakers to play a large portion of the second half without him, so as to not lose him later in the game. item.title: Major setback awaits JJ Gabriel at Real Madrid after highly publicised Man United exit
item.description: Major setback awaits JJ Gabriel at Real Madrid after highly publicised Man United exit JJ Gabriel is reportedly set for an immediate setback at Real Madrid following his highly controversial Manchester United exit. Acrimonious departure A week ago, Gabriel confirmed his United exit via social media, putting an end to weeks of speculation over his future. In September, he and his representatives stunned United by officially requesting the club to cancel his registration. He subsequently withdrew from training at Carrington, choosing instead to follow his own individual programme in Spain. United’s attempts to persuade him to stay went unanswered by the player’s camp. A report covered by The Peoples Person relayed that United found out about Gabriel’s exit via his social media announcement. United may still hold the teenager’s registration until the season’s end, but it will not stop him from moving to a European Union club; he now possesses an EU passport through his mother, who is of Cypriot heritage. It’s understood that Gabriel has a verbal agreement to join Madrid . The move is expected to go through at the turn of the year. However, according to the Manchester Evening News , the teenager faces an immediate problem once he signs on the dotted line. Gabriel put in his place According to the newspaper, Gabriel is set to begin his career at Real Madrid in a low-key fashion, with the Spanish giants guided by their prior experience of having Arsenal captain Martin Odegaard. Neither Castilla, Real Madrid’s B team, nor the C team may sign players before January. It could be a blow to him and his father, one of whose stated grievances for leaving United was wanting greater involvement with the senior squad. Madrid’s plan is for Gabriel to train and play for the B team. It’s understood that Madrid are eager not to repeat the mistakes they made with Odegaard a decade ago. Having been signed at the age of 15, Odegaard was rushed into the first team but struggled to secure playing time under Carlo Ancelotti and Zinedine Zidane, making it eventually necessary for him to depart the Santiago Bernabeu to preserve his career. item.title: RB Leipzig and PreZero extend partnership until 2029
item.description: RB Leipzig and PreZero extend partnership until 2029 RB Leipzig and PreZero have extended their partnership, which began in 2022, by a further three years until 30th June 2029 . The Neckarsulm-based company will remain an Official Supplier of the Red Bulls and continue to advise the club on matters relating to the circular economy. The two partners share a common goal: to use resources responsibly, keep materials in circulation and develop innovative ideas within football. Putting the circular economy into practice – from stadium seats to Zero Waste Two projects in particular highlight what the partnership has achieved so far: In May 2024, the Red Bull Arena’s waste and recycling management system was certified by TÜV Süd in line with DIN SPEC 91436 “Zero Waste” at Bronze maturity level. At the time, more than 85% of waste generated on the stadium grounds was already being recycled or undergoing other forms of material recovery. This rate had more than doubled since 2019. The old blue stadium seats from the Red Bull Arena have also been given a second life. As part of the “SEATainability” project, they were recycled into Soccercourt boards. Seats that once accommodated fans now serve a new purpose on a football pitch. Stephan Czieplik, Chief Revenue Officer at RB Leipzig: “We’ve achieved a great deal together with PreZero since 2022. The Zero Waste certification of our Red Bull Arena and projects such as SEATainability demonstrate what’s possible through our partnership. We want to continue developing new ideas that conserve resources while delivering tangible benefits for our club.” Discover more Fixtures Red Bull Arena Men's first team Tickets Fan Zone

item.title: The Blue Jays’ reported offer for Tarik Skubal revealed after his $450 million Mets deal
item.description: Photo by Michael Reaves/Getty Images Tarik Skubal has signed the largest pitching contract in MLB history with the New York Mets, but the Toronto Blue Jays put a pretty large offer on the table themselves. After a brief stint with the Los Angeles Dodgers, Tarik Skubal will now play for the New York Mets starting next season. The two-time Cy Young Award winner signed a deal worth $450 million over nine years with the franchise, comfortably surpassing Yoshinobu Yamamoto’s massive deal with his former team. Skubal has had many suitors since it became evident that he would be leaving the Detroit Tigers last year. The Dodgers got him in a trade, but it soon became clear that other teams were waiting to pounce on the pitcher in free agency. And now, the Blue Jays’ reported offer to Skubal has been revealed. The Toronto Blue Jays reportedly gave Tarik Skubal a $420 million contract offer Toronto had been among the teams competing for his signature, alongside the Mets, Dodgers and San Diego Padres. If reports are to be believed, the Dodgers never made a formal offer, and the Mets came out as the eventual winners in the sweepstakes. item.title: Rob Gronkowski is ‘a little worried’ about the Jacksonville Jaguars after what he’s noticed
item.description: Photo by Paras Griffin/Getty Images Rob Gronkowski has suggested that the Jacksonville Jaguars are starting to make him a ‘little worried’ due to their inconsistency, which he thinks was on display against the New York Giants in Week 11. The Jaguars managed just 18 points against the Giants, their lowest points total since mid-September when they were beaten 20-13 by the Denver Broncos. Despite the recent 23-18 loss to the Giants, the Jags are still comfortably top of the AFC South and look pretty nailed on for a playoff berth. However, Gronkowski is worried that Jacksonville use up all their ‘greatness’ in the regular season and then struggle in the playoffs. Rob Gronkowski suggests Jaguars are too inconsistent during playoffs Speaking to NFL on Fox , he said: “I am a little worried about the Jags because of their inconsistency. They kind of showed and displayed this last year. Yeah, they’ve got a great team and they can show greatness at times, but then they hit the playoffs, the last couple of years, and boom, they just unload in a terrible way. It’s like they unload all their greatness.” Talking specifically about the Week 11 loss, he added: “It’s like they’ve used it all up throughout the whole season, and now they’re already showing periods like this game and moments where they’re just not showing up. They’ve got to show up on a consistent basis. “It’s not like, ‘Hey, you know, the playoffs are kicking in. We’re going to dominate now. We’re going to play our best football’. You’ve got to continue to play your best football throughout the whole year, especially against solid opponents. “Like the New York Giants. Yes, they shocked everyone, but they’re a solid team. Harbaugh is a great coach, you know? They’ve got McCarthy now. They’re playing together as a team. They want to win. It’s like there are no individuals. “Everyone’s in it together with the New York Giants. I’m not saying the Jags aren’t. I mean, I feel like there aren’t any individuals on that team, but they’re just too inconsistent over the years.” The Jaguars made it to the Wild Card Playoffs in 2025, losing 27-24 against the Buffalo Bills and you could make a case that their inconsistency was on display then. Trevor Lawrence is one of the top quarterbacks in the NFL but against the Bills, he threw a game-losing interception in the final few minutes, which cost his side. Prior to that, they competed in the 2022/23 season playoffs and were bested by the Kansas City Chiefs when Nick Bolton and Jaylen Watson capitalised on fumbles and interceptions in the fourth quarter to help their team win 27-20. It does feel like the Jaguars are never really blown away when they are beaten in the postseason. Instead, individual errors or lapses in concentration seem to be what costs them. But it’s hard to predict if that will change in 2026/27, as apart from the Giants’ loss, they have looked like one of the most complete teams in the regular campaign. item.description: Photo by Perry Knotts/Getty Images The Thanksgiving game between the Kansas City Chiefs and the Buffalo Bills is the marquee fixture, and the latter have done something ‘incredible’ with Josh Allen to prepare him for it. When the Kansas City Chiefs take on the Buffalo Bills on Thanksgiving night, it will be a clash between two marquee quarterbacks and two winning teams. Patrick Mahomes is not surrendering his position and Josh Allen is coming for it, while this could easily be the Super Bowl game this season. To prepare Allen for this game in the best possible way, the Bills did something ‘incredible’ during their recent game against the Dolphins. Josh Allen protected against the Dolphins The Bills faced no issues dispatching the Dolphins in their recent game to go 9-1 this season and cement themselves as the best team in the NFL. Allen managed to gain 304 yards with his passing, completing 27/45 attempts, but it was a sloppy game by his usually world-class standards. NFL reporter Jordan Schultz, speaking on Ryan Clarke’s The Pivot podcast, said that Allen’s game was by design, as the Bills prioritised protecting him at all costs. Schultz said that for the first time ever, Allen took no part in any rushes, design runs, or scrambles, and that was all intentional. He said: “Something happened Sunday against Miami. And I’m looking at it right now. This is pretty incredible because I want to make sure I get this right. Josh Allen, this is the first time we’ve ever seen this in his career. He finished the game with zero rushing attempts. “No design runs, no scrambles, nothing. Everything went through the passing game or the running backs. And my understanding is that this was very strictly and deliberately by design. Buffalo wanted to make sure that Josh was fresh for Thursday, when the entire playbook will be available and he’ll be fully unleashed.” It is no surprise to see the Bills preparing this way for a game that could go a long way towards solidifying their championship prospects and placing Allen as the MVP favourite. Allen is now well-rested and safe to play to his full strengths in a game that will be watched and analysed by millions, and the Bills’ gamble will be spoken about as genius if they win that game after winning against the Dolphins as well. item.description: PHILADELPHIA -- The Philadelphia 76ers played host to the Portland Trail Blazers on Monday night looking to keep things moving in the right direction. Unfortunately, a lack of size and 3-point production did them in as the Sixers fell to the Blazers 128-111 to fall to 14-4 on the season. Portland won the rebounding battle 49-33 led by Donovan Clingan's 18 rebounds and the Blazers were able to have a ton of success on the offensive end due to the size advantage. One has to give Walker credit for giving it his all. It was obvious that he was ready to battle and do what he had to do, but he can't help the size mismatch with Clingan and Co. in Portland. "I think the biggest challenge is just how much help you can provide," Walker said after the loss. "Sometimes when the guards get downhill, it makes you question whether you can help and then get back. So that’s always in your mind when a guy like that is on the floor." Brown's foul trouble Brown looked phenomenal to start the night as he scored 19 points on 8-for-10 shooting in the first half as Philadelphia was able to keep up with Portland. Photograph: Matt Slocum/AP When Giannis Antetokounmpo announced he was taking an investment stake in prediction market Kalshi in February, the claim he made to accompany the announcement – “We all on Kalshi now” – sounded as absurd as the howls of outrage from sports lovers seemed universal. Nine months later, Kalshi’s grip on American fans appears murderously tight: notional monthly trading volume on the platform, the majority of which is taken up by wagers on sports, increased to nearly $100bn in October from $40bn in August, as the company gears up for yet another funding round at a rumored valuation of $65bn ahead of a potential IPO. Rival prediction market Polymarket, which relaunched in the US late last year after regulators shut it down in 2022, has seen similar growth over recent months. However righteous the disgust from fans on social media at the deepening incursion of these odious platforms into professional sport may be, their popularity seems only to grow. More perplexing is the widening circle of athletes like Giannis who’ve thrown off whatever shame might once have come from association with these businesses and given them their full-throated support. The line between role model and shill in professional sports is now essentially non-existent. Pete Sampras, a man so private in retirement it can often seem like his entire tennis career was a collective hallucination, released an ad for Kalshi during this year’s US Open after two decades largely out of the public eye. José Mourinho trousered a brick of Kalshi cash this summer in exchange for a gambling promo during the World Cup. The prediction market machine now sponsors Jalen Brunson and Josh Hart’s Roommates Show, on which the recently crowned pair of NBA champions begin every episode dutifully informing us that their amazingly dreary podcast is “presented by Polymarket, the top prediction market”. Somehow we’ve arrived at the point where it’s bigger news if a professional athlete takes a firm stand against the prediction markets, as Victor Wembanyama recently did , rather than pockets the cash to endorse them. item.description: Relief for Arsenal as Raya has not suffered a serious injury Arsenal have received a major boost after David Raya’s injury proved less serious than initially feared, with the goalkeeper potentially returning to action this weekend. item.description: Barcelona declare in-form midfielder untouchable amid Chelsea and Manchester United interest According to Fabrizio Romano (h/t SPORT ), Barcelona have no intention of entertaining offers for Fermin Lopez amid growing interest in the in-form midfielder, particularly from the Premier League. The midfielder’s outstanding performances have attracted attention from the likes of Chelsea and Manchester United , but the Catalan giants’ position is clear: Fermin is untouchable. Not for sale Fermin’s development under Hansi Flick over the past couple of seasons has been remarkable. He has become one of Barcelona’s most influential players, thanks to his energy, relentless pressing and the goal threat he offers from the attacking midfield position. This season alone, the 23-year-old La Masia graduate has registered a tally of nine goals and seven assists from 16 games across all competitions, and is only behind Raphinha and Lamine Yamal in the team’s scoring charts. In top form. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images) Fermin has now found the back of the net in consecutive games, having scored both of Barcelona’s goals against Atletico Madrid and then netted the equaliser in the team’s 3-2 comeback win over Villarreal last Sunday. Given his meteoric rise, interest from the Premier League has intensified. Chelsea had already made approaches for Fermin during the summer of 2025 and remain on the lookout, while Manchester United have also expressed an interest. But, as far as Barcelona are concerned, they have no plans to open negotiations over a potential departure for the 23-year-old star. While they recognise the potential financial return from selling a player of Fermin’s profile, the Blaugrana believe his importance on the pitch outweighs any immediate economic benefit. Fermin also wants to stay Meanwhile, Fermin himself has no desire to leave Barcelona, having penned a long-term contract with the club in January, committing his future until the summer of 2029. item.description: Former Australia opener Matthew Hayden has expressed his disappointment with the 2018 Australian side over the infamous Sandpapergate controversy, saying the team failed to uphold one of the defining characteristics of its cricketing culture – confronting problems collectively inside the dressing room. With the ball-tampering scandal back in the spotlight following fresh revelations by former Australia batter Usman Khawaja and Cameron Bancroft, Hayden believes the focus will eventually shift back to cricket, with Australia having several important assignments ahead, including the Border-Gavaskar Trophy (BGT) in India from January 21, 2027. However, while backing Australia's competitive spirit and its traditional winning culture, Hayden was particularly critical of the players involved in the 2018 episode for not resolving the matter internally. "Will Australia want to win? That's my first question. I can, hand on heart, tell you that Australia will not only be competitive, but will also want to win. In the context of cricket, Australia has largely been very fair in the way it has gone about its cricketing culture. Very little has disrupted the nature of the Australian winning culture. It's a very in-your-face culture. It will confront issues inside the change room collectively. That's why I'm really disappointed in this 2018 mob that couldn't do it," Hayden said on JioStar. Hayden backs Cummins' handling of controversy Hayden also praised current Australia captain Pat Cummins for addressing the renewed questions surrounding the scandal head-on, describing his willingness to face scrutiny and present his version of events as a position of strength. Cummins had dismissed Khawaja's allegations as "utter nonsense" during a press conference, insisting that the bowling group was unaware of the ball-tampering plan. His comments subsequently triggered another round of debate, with Bancroft publishing a lengthy column in The West Australian. Hayden, however, feels the game has largely moved on from the controversy and that the focus will soon return to performances on the field. "Largely, the game has already moved on. Pat Cummins, as you can see, is very keen to embrace his leadership style. He came out with an hour-and-a-bit press conference and said, 'Guys, this is what I've got to say. item.title: Cole Palmer’s Form: Is The Chelsea Number 10 Still Undroppable?
item.description: At various points last season, Cole Palmer’s form was considered one of the major reasons behind Chelsea’s disappointing campaign. While some supporters rightly attributed the club’s 10th-place finish to Enzo Maresca’s departure midway through the season, others believed that the club would have achieved much more had their star player remained fit. Palmer struggled with a persistent groin injury for much of the campaign, limiting his influence when the team needed him most. However, this season, Chelsea supporters have begun asking some uncomfortable questions about the Englishman. Having recovered from his injury and having missed the 2026 World Cup, many expected the Chelsea number 10 to have sufficient time to rest, recover and rediscover his best form. Indeed, the beginning of the campaign suggested that the “ice-man” was ready to replicate his impressive 2023/24 Premier League numbers, as he recorded five goal contributions in his first six league appearances. Since then, however, his performances have taken a worrying downturn. Palmer has managed just one goal in his last five league appearances, with several displays leaving him looking almost invisible on the pitch. This has understandably frustrated supporters who expect considerably more from a player regarded as the creative heartbeat of Chelsea’s attack. At Stamford Bridge, reputation and past achievements can only buy a player so much patience. Palmer remains one of the club’s most talented players, but his recent performances have raised legitimate questions about his consistency, his influence on the team’s attacking play and whether he should retain his automatic starting position. Cole Palmer’s Form: Why Chelsea Fans Are Beginning To Question His Undroppable Status Chelsea’s 4–1 defeat to Leeds United at Stamford Bridge , their first home defeat to the Yorkshire club in 27 years, was embarrassing enough. The team’s overall display, particularly given the historical rivalry between both sides, sparked an extraordinary backlash from Chelsea supporters on social media over the weekend. Despite previous calls from sections of the fanbase to give Xabi Alonso time to implement his ideas and establish his preferred style of play, that patience appears to be running out. Supporters are now demanding the sale of several players they believe are not fighting hard enough for the badge. The Chelsea defence has attracted particular criticism, with fans accusing several players of being too weak and easily bullied by Leeds’ attackers. French defender Wesley Fofana has been among the biggest targets , with some supporters already calling for his immediate departure in the upcoming January transfer window. It was also the 38-year-old’s first fight since a civil jury found him liable for sexual assault in 2024. McGregor appealed the verdict, which related to an alleged incident in 2018, but his appeal failed. He continues to deny all allegations against him. McGregor is without a win in the UFC since 2020, when he stopped Donald Cerrone in 40 seconds. Since then he has fought just three times, suffering a knockout by Poirier in January 2021 before breaking his leg in their next meeting, six months later. Then came his rematch with Holloway. item.description: Nebraska football pulled off a long-awaited win this past weekend, taking down No. 14 Ohio State , 31-28. Nebraska also managed to close out the win after letting multiple contests slip through its fingers not just this season, but in numerous seasons before it. But most importantly, he played mostly mistake-free. He tallied 263 total yards and four touchdowns. Colandrea finished 19-of-28 for 200 yards and three touchdowns in the air, hitting his receivers at clutch moments. On the ground, he picked up 63 rushing yards and a touchdown on 11 carries, coming through on some of the biggest plays of, not just the game, but arguably of the season. However, while these plays were massive, they don’t fully overshadow the few moments of terror that unfolded in the game. Colandrea still missed a number of throws, some dangerously close to being in harm’s way. He also just avoided putting the ball on the ground on two separate runs, getting a knee or forearm down in the nick of time. In past games, those close calls didn’t go Nebraska’s way. item.title: Grandmaster clash: World Chess enters record books as Gen Z contenders fight for title
item.description: Two titans of Chess go head-to-head in Geneva on Tuesday in a match that will be the most youthful world championship contest in the competition's 140-year history. Defending the crown is India's Dommaraju Gukesh, who entered the record books in 2024, when he took the title at 18-years old. He's up against Javokhir Sindarov of Uzbekistan, who's also 20, and for some is favourite to win based on form, having won the World Cup and Candidates Tournament. He's currently fourth in the global rankings compared to Gukesh, who's dropped to 26th. Sindarov also goes into the battle with a psychological advantage with two victories and one draw from their three previous encounters. But, at the press conference on Sunday at the United Nations’ European headquarters where both players presented themselves to the world, Gukesh rejected suggestions that he faced a more difficult task this time round to protect his title. “I don’t think I’m here to defend anything,” he said. “I’m here to win it all over again. That’s the mindset I’m in.” Related The incredible hidden details you missed in Ronaldo and Messi's viral chess photo FILE: The trophy of World Championship 2026 is seen during the opening ceremony of the FIDE World Chess Championship, 22 November 2026 - Salvatore Di Nolfi/Keystone via AP The tournament is taking place at the Fondation Martin Bodmer at Cologny, one of the most important private libraries in the world, as it includes some of the oldest surviving copies of the New Testament and Shakespeare's First Folio from 1623. The match will consist of 14 classical games. The first player to score 7.5 points or more will be crowned World Champion and claim the larger share of the total prize fund of $2.5 million. If the score is equal after 14 games, the winner will be decided by a tiebreak which will be played on 12 December.
